channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont drivers should prepare for more road work starting Monday. Projects on I-eighty-nine, Vermont fourteen, and other highways will cause lane closures and slowdowns. Officials urge caution and patience through these construction zones to keep everyone safe.

Port Henry in Essex County New York has a new 'Champ' sightings board. It replaces a board that stood for over forty years and lists more than one hundred thirty reported sightings of the legendary Lake Champlain creature. The town used occupancy tax funds to commission and install the colorful new sign.

Rutland is updating the way it replaces police cruisers, now factoring in idling time as part of mileage wear. One hour of idling equals thirty miles of driving, officials say. The policy change awaits final approval by the city and state.

Lake Placid will get two new monuments honoring the nineteen eighty Olympic Winter Games. The project includes statues celebrating the Miracle on Ice hockey team and speed skater Eric Heiden. The monument is set to open in February two thousand thirty at the Olympic Center.
